metadata.title: Crap From The Past - September 16, 2002: Re-recordings II
metadata.description: A pop music radio show for people who already know plenty about pop music, hosted by Ron "Boogiemonster" Gerber. From March 1999 - October 2002, the show ran every Sunday night from midnight-2am on KFAI-FM, 90.3 FM Minneapolis, 106.7 FM St. Paul, and KFAI.org.

metadata.subject: Crap From The Past; KFAI

reviews.reviewbody:
The Boogiemonster does it again.  I have recently "discovered" Ron and his Crap from the Past, and have been listening daily for about eight hours a day.  This is my first review of one of his shows - the second I've listened to today.  
This is the second part to "Re-recordings," which appeared earlier in the summer of 2002.  This episode shifts its concentration from "cheesy re-recordings" to a more narrow "songs re-recorded for larger labels later on."  The array of things Ron digs up are great - paralleling many songs I might have played if faced with creating this type of tracklist ("Disco Song" vs. "Once I Had a Love" vs. "Heart of Glass," "Vacation," etc.).  The Boogiemonster offers some excellent commentary, and when combined with his song selection, this show truly is a standout in the "Crap" archives!
